# Requirements Checklist: Real Mode Depth -- Comparison & Cost Tracking

**Purpose**: PR-review-depth validation of spec.md 004's requirements quality (completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, coverage) before `/speckit.tasks` -- general review across both User Stories, not implementation verification.
**Created**: 2026-08-10
**Reviewed**: 2026-08-10 -- against spec.md, plan.md, research.md, data-model.md, contracts/, tasks.md, quickstart.md (all now present, post-`/speckit.tasks`/`/speckit.analyze`)
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Does spec.md enumerate which specific real-call sites (Retrieval step, Embedding step, Generation step, Compare Variants, recall@K eval, chunk-size sweep) are in scope for cumulative ledger tracking, or is this left implicit under "across an entire Real Mode session"? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-005] -- **Resolved** (not in spec.md itself, but unambiguously in plan.md's Summary and tasks.md T021-T026, which enumerate all five/six sites by name).
- [x] CHK002 Does the SessionCostLedger entity description account for the pending-reset-decision state FR-006 requires, or is that omitted from Key Entities? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities] -- **Resolved**: omitted from spec.md's Key Entities prose, but data-model.md's `SessionCostLedger` interface adds the `pendingResetPrompt: boolean` field explicitly.
- [x] CHK003 Does spec.md define what the Simulated half shows when a non-naive (HyDE/RAG-Fusion) configuration is selected, or is this left entirely to planning? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-002a] -- **Resolved**: spec.md left it open by design (plan.md's Summary says so explicitly); research.md's "Simulated half for HyDE/RAG-Fusion configurations" decision resolves it unambiguously before tasks were generated.
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements defined for what happens if the learner raises or lowers the warning threshold after it has already been crossed mid-session? [Completeness, Gap] -- **Resolved by construction**: the gate is a live `sumLedgerUsd(ledger) >= ledger.warningThresholdUsd` check re-evaluated before every action (contracts/cost-ledger-contract.md), not a one-time latch, so raising/lowering the threshold takes effect on the very next check with no special-case logic needed.
- [x] CHK005 Does spec.md include an explicit accessibility acceptance scenario/FR for the new warning banner, reset-prompt banner, and configuration selector controls, the way 003-parameter-exploration's clarify pass explicitly added one for its sweep curve? [Completeness, Gap, Non-Functional] -- **Resolved outside spec.md**: plan.md's Constitution Check (Principle VII row) names the exact reused accessible patterns (`aria-pressed` selector, `ErrorBanner`'s `role="alert"`/keyboard pattern) per control, and tasks.md T012/T031 are dedicated a11y test tasks for them -- an implementer has everything needed even without a spec.md-level scenario.

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is "inspectable side by side" (FR-002) specified with enough precision to distinguish a compliant UI (e.g., a merged table) from a non-compliant one (e.g., two separate charts a learner must eyeball)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002] -- **Resolved**: contracts/comparison-contract.md's "Pairing ranks" section mandates a merged table/list rendering explicitly, not two separate charts; data-model.md's `ChunkRankPair` gives the exact merged shape.
- [x] CHK007 Is "any step" in FR-005 defined to include all three top-level views (Pipeline Walkthrough, Compare Variants, and the new comparison view), not just pipeline steps within Pipeline Walkthrough? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005] -- **Resolved**: plan.md's Summary and tasks.md T020 both explicitly say "all three views."
- [x] CHK008 Does SC-002 specify whether "individual actions' own estimates" means one estimate per learner-facing action or per underlying API call, given a single action (e.g., one HyDE run) comprises multiple real calls? [Clarity, Ambiguity, Spec §SC-002] -- **Resolved**: data-model.md and cost-ledger-contract.md both state explicitly "one entry per underlying call... never per learner-facing action."
- [x] CHK009 Does FR-007 specify whether the crossed-threshold warning reappears before every subsequent call, or only the first time the threshold is crossed? [Clarity, Gap, Spec §FR-007] -- **Resolved**: cost-ledger-contract.md states it's "a per-action gate, not a global lock... requires one extra explicit click per action from then on for the rest of the session."
- [x] CHK010 Is the mapping from each `RealModeError.kind` (invalid-key, network, rate-limit, partial-failure, other) to "billable vs. not billable" documented, or left to implementer judgment at build time? [Clarity, Gap, Spec §Assumptions] -- **Resolved by construction**: `createLedgerTrackingProvider` (cost-ledger-contract.md) records an entry only on success and nothing on any rejection, regardless of `RealModeError.kind` -- this uniformly implements spec.md's own Assumptions default ("favor undercounting") without needing a per-kind table.

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK011 Are "practitioner" (User Story framing) and "learner" (Acceptance Scenarios, Functional Requirements, Edge Cases, and every other spec in this project) intended as the same actor, and should terminology be normalized? [Consistency, Terminology, Spec §User Scenarios] -- **Resolved**: spec.md's US1/US2 preambles now say "learner," matching the rest of the document and every other spec in this project.
- [x] CHK012 Does FR-006's "the active document" account for the fact that Pipeline Walkthrough, Compare Variants, and the new comparison view each maintain independent document selection (per Milestone 2's established pattern)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006] -- **Resolved**: research.md's reset-prompt decision explicitly lists each view's own doc-change handler as a trigger.
- [x] CHK013 Are the pricing-assumption-basis labeling requirements (FR-008) consistent between the per-action cost estimate (FR-003) and the cumulative ledger display (FR-005)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008] -- **Resolved by construction**: both read the same single `PricingTable.label` (data-model.md) -- one source of truth, not two independently-maintained labels.
- [x] CHK014 Is the FR-XXX(letter) suffix numbering scheme (FR-002a, FR-004a) used for clarification-driven insertions applied consistently, and does it read unambiguously alongside the plain-numbered FRs around it? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002a / §FR-004a] -- **Resolved**: verified by inspection -- both lettered FRs are placed immediately after their base FR with no ambiguity.

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK015 Can SC-001's "readable without additional clicks" be objectively verified, or does it depend on a subjective judgment call? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001] -- **Resolved**: translates concretely to "the merged rank table renders synchronously with no expand/collapse/modal gate" (T008's always-rendered table + T011's Playwright assertion) -- objectively checkable, not subjective.
- [x] CHK016 Is a specific sample document/question pinned for SC-001's "at least one shipped sample document/question," or is any document/question combination acceptable? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001] -- **Resolved**: SC-001's own wording only requires existence of one working example ("at least one"), not a specific pinned one -- self-satisfied by any of the app's existing shipped `sampleDocs.ts` fixtures, which T011's test will use.
- [x] CHK017 Does SC-003's "100% of comparisons requiring a real call" scope match FR-005's app-wide ledger requirement, or is SC-003 narrower (comparison view only) while FR-005 is broader (every real action)? [Consistency, Spec §SC-003 / §FR-005] -- **Resolved directly in spec.md**: SC-003's own text (post-clarify) states the scope distinction explicitly, in parentheses.
- [x] CHK018 Is SC-004's "deliberately triggering the threshold in testing" specific enough to know what constitutes a passing test (e.g., exact tolerance for "before, not after")? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004] -- **Resolved**: it's a hard gate, not a timing race -- cost-ledger-contract.md's mechanism means the call literally cannot fire until "Proceed anyway" is clicked, so "before, not after" has no tolerance ambiguity to specify.

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK019 Are requirements defined for concurrent/overlapping real actions across different views (e.g., a Retrieval-step embed effect still in flight while the comparison view's Real half is also triggered) regarding ledger accounting order? [Coverage, Gap] -- **Resolved by design**: `SessionCostLedger.entries` is an append-only array summed at read time (`sumLedgerUsd`), not a single running total mutated in place -- ordering of concurrent completions doesn't affect correctness, so no special concurrency requirement was needed.
- [x] CHK020 Are requirements defined for what the comparison view shows if the learner switches configuration (naive/HyDE/RAG-Fusion) mid-run, before the Real half completes? [Coverage, Gap] -- **Resolved**: research.md's new "Configuration selector during an in-flight Real half" decision -- the selector is disabled with an accessible reason while `realStatus === "running"`, re-enabling once it settles; documented in spec.md's Edge Cases, comparison-contract.md, and tasks.md T005/T012.
- [x] CHK021 Are requirements defined for a learner entering an API key for the first time while already viewing the comparison view (FR-004a's no-key state resolving mid-session) -- does the Real half auto-activate or require a separate explicit action? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-004a] -- **Resolved by construction**: comparison-contract.md's Real half section makes activation a separate explicit action regardless of key timing -- FR-003's disclosure-before-call requirement means the confirm button is always required anyway, key or no key.

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK022 Does the Edge Cases section address whether a lowered warning threshold (rather than only a rising total) can also newly cross an already-accumulated total, re-triggering the warning? [Edge Case, Gap] -- **Resolved by construction**: same live re-evaluation mechanism as CHK004 -- the gate doesn't distinguish whether the crossing came from a rising total or a lowered threshold.
- [x] CHK023 Is the "no billable request" vs. "consumed quota before failing" distinction (Edge Cases) resolvable for every `RealModeError.kind` this app already defines, or only some of them? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases] -- **Resolved**: same uniform success/failure rule as CHK010 -- works identically for all `RealModeErrorKind` values without needing to inspect which kind occurred.

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK024 Are performance/latency expectations defined for the comparison view's Real half, given it may involve multiple sequential calls (HyDE/RAG-Fusion) rather than naive RAG's simpler path? [Non-Functional, Gap] -- **Resolved**: plan.md's Performance Goals explicitly states no SLA beyond "feeling responsive," latency is provider-dependent -- a deliberate scope decision, consistent with Milestone 2's existing stance, not a silent omission.
- [x] CHK025 Are keyboard-operability and accessible-naming requirements explicitly stated for the new configuration selector, reset-prompt banner, and warning banner, or only implied by Constitution Principle VII generally? [Non-Functional, Gap] -- **Resolved**: plan.md's Constitution Check names the exact reused pattern per control (not just a general principle citation), backed by dedicated tasks T012/T031.

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK026 Is the assumption of "a single configurable pricing table per provider" validated against the fact that this app currently ships only one provider (OpenAI) -- i.e., is multi-provider pricing explicitly out of scope, or silently assumed away? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions] -- **Resolved**: data-model.md states this explicitly -- one shipped value this milestone, keyed by `providerId` so a second provider is additive, not silently assumed away.
- [x] CHK027 Is the dependency on Milestone 2's completion (Assumptions) cross-referenced to a specific, verifiable Definition-of-Done statement, rather than asserted narratively? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions] -- **Resolved**: roadmap.md records Milestone 2's (and Milestone 3's) Definition of Done as met, with a verifiable task/check count, and gates Milestone 4 on it per the constitution's own Development Workflow rule.

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK028 Does spec.md clarify whether "estimated cost" in FR-005/FR-008 is meant to match the per-call estimate methodology used for the pre-call disclosure (FR-003), or could an implementer read these as two independently-defined estimation methods? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-005 / §FR-008] -- **Resolved by construction**: both the pre-call estimate (`costEstimateUsd()`) and the ledger's recorded `costUsd` per entry read from the same `PricingTable` object -- structurally guaranteed to match, and T028's check verifies this identity directly.
- [x] CHK029 Is GraphRAG/Self-RAG/Agentic RAG's exclusion from FR-002a's configuration selector stated in spec.md 004 itself, or only inferable by cross-referencing spec.md 002's Assumptions? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-002a] -- **Resolved**: stated directly in spec.md 004's own FR-002a text, which names all three excluded approaches (citing spec.md 002 for the underlying rationale, which is expected cross-referencing, not the only source).
